tasks.title: Electrical hover power through FM
tasks.statement: A vehicle of **{m} kg**, **{n}** props of **{d} inches** each, system FM = **{fm}**. Find the electrical hover power of the propulsion system in watts (ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, g = 9.81).
tasks.solution: A = n·π·(D/2)², D = d·0.0254 m; P_ideal = (m·g)^1.5 / √(2ρA); electrical power = P_ideal / FM.

tasks.title: Hover time down to the reserve
tasks.statement: A 6S**{p}**P battery of **{e} Wh** cells. 85 % of the energy comes out, and the reserve is 20 % of what is available. The hover power including onboard loads is **{pw} W**. Find the time down to the reserve in minutes.

tasks.title: Closing the mass budget
tasks.statement: The payload, avionics, motors and battery together weigh **{mf} kg**, and the frame is **{f} %** of the takeoff mass. Find the takeoff mass in kilograms.
tasks.solution: m = m_without_frame / (1 − f_frame): the frame grows with the vehicle, so you cannot simply add its mass.

tasks.title: Tilt into the wind
tasks.statement: A multirotor of **{m} kg** holds an airspeed of **{v} m/s**, CdA = **{cda} m²**. Find the tilt angle in degrees (ρ = 1.225, g = 9.81).
tasks.solution: D = ½·ρ·V²·CdA; θ = atan(D / (m·g)). The thrust is then √((mg)² + D²), and that is what you compare with the maximum.
